name: How to Verify a Driveway Contractor in Los Angeles County

mainEntity.name: How do I know if a driveway contractor is licensed and insured in Los Angeles County?
mainEntity.text: How do I know if a driveway contractor is licensed and insured in Los Angeles County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowners should ask for the contractor’s license number, certificate of insurance, and written proposal before work begins. The business name on the estimate should match the name on the license and insurance paperwork, and the scope should clearly cover driveway work such as demolition, concrete, paving, grading, or drainage. Insurance matters because driveway projects often involve heavy equipment, hauling, and concrete or excavation work. If employees are working on site, workers’ compensation coverage is especially important. A trustworthy contractor will not hesitate to provide documentation and explain what is covered. It is also smart to confirm that the company has local experience in Los Angeles County, since city-specific rules, access issues, and inspection requirements can affect the job. If a contractor refuses to provide proof or gives vague answers, that is a warning sign to keep shopping.
acceptedAnswer.description: A legitimate driveway contractor should be able to provide a license number, proof of general liability insurance, and workers’ compensation coverage if employees are on site. The name on the bid should match the business name on the license and insurance documents. Homeowners should also verify that the contractor’s scope of work matches the actual driveway project before signing.
